follow-up time: Until delivery for those who conceived
cohort: 185 women who underwent laparoscopic myomectomy for uterine myomas and desired pregnancy
finding: Laparoscopic myomectomy demonstrated good reproductive outcomes, with comparable pregnancy and abortion rates to the existing literature, and no contraindications for vaginal delivery after adequate myometrial closure.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was achievable in a significant proportion of women after laparoscopic myomectomy, with no contraindications reported after adequate closure of the myometrium.
